Gonggong, dieu des eaux furieux, a jadis: Gonggong, the furious water god, once broke the mountain that held up the sky with a blow of his head. He wants to stop the academy’s great debate: defend your ideas with order and reason.
Examen blanc au format du HSK 3, en chin: Mock exam in HSK 3 format, in Chinese: listening (听力), reading (阅读) and writing (书写). Marked out of 300; pass mark 180 points.
Les listes de vocabulaire de Koto Quest: Koto Quest’s vocabulary lists follow the HSK 3 syllabus (HSK 2.0, used in the 2026 sessions) but are not official lists of the Centre for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC).
Les caractères du HSK 3 vus dans le parc: The HSK 3 characters seen in the path, with their pinyin and meaning. Same character, same mastery as in the lessons.
Questions rédigées par Koto Quest au for: Questions written by Koto Quest in the format of the official HSK 3 exam (HSK 2.0: question types, instructions in Chinese, scoring out of 300). Pictures are replaced by pictograms and writing is multiple choice. They are not official questions.
